derivation.note: Each export is its source with the gain that brings it to the target loudness, measured by ffmpeg's ebur128 filter, then a limiter, as mono MP3 without metadata. Where the limiter takes more than 0.5 LU, the gain is raised by the difference and the conversion made again, up to 3 conversions in all.

grabby_capture_1.direction: [gleeful] Mine! [smug] I'll take that, thank you.
grabby_capture_1.text: Mine! I'll take that, thank you.

grabby_capture_2.direction: [smug] Another piece added to my private collection.
grabby_capture_2.text: Another piece added to my private collection.

grabby_capture_3.direction: [mischievously] Yoink! [snickers] You shouldn't leave valuables lying around.
grabby_capture_3.text: Yoink! You shouldn't leave valuables lying around.

grabby_capture_heavy_1.direction: [laughs] Jackpot! That prize piece is mine!
grabby_capture_heavy_1.text: Jackpot! That prize piece is mine!

grabby_capture_heavy_2.direction: [gasps] Exquisite loot! [gleeful] A crown jewel for my hoard!
grabby_capture_heavy_2.text: Exquisite loot! A crown jewel for my hoard!

grabby_capture_heavy_3.direction: [gleeful] The bigger the piece, the sweeter the profit! [laughs]
grabby_capture_heavy_3.text: The bigger the piece, the sweeter the profit!

grabby_empty_roll_1.direction: [frustrated] No moves?! But I wanted to take something!
grabby_empty_roll_1.text: No moves?! But I wanted to take something!

grabby_empty_roll_2.direction: [annoyed] A waste of a roll! [sighs] No loot for my vault this turn.
grabby_empty_roll_2.text: A waste of a roll! No loot for my vault this turn.

grabby_empty_roll_3.direction: [sarcastic] Empty roll! You got lucky... [menacing] for now.
grabby_empty_roll_3.text: Empty roll! You got lucky... for now.

grabby_intro_1.direction: [mischievously] Everything on this board belongs in my collection.
grabby_intro_1.text: Everything on this board belongs in my collection.

grabby_intro_2.direction: [smug] Don't get attached to your pieces. [snickers] I'm taking them all.
grabby_intro_2.text: Don't get attached to your pieces. I'm taking them all.

grabby_intro_3.direction: [excited] A fresh board! [whispers] So many shiny pieces to hoard.
grabby_intro_3.text: A fresh board! So many shiny pieces to hoard.

grabby_loss_1.direction: [shouting] No! [crying] My glorious collection! [angry] How dare you?!
grabby_loss_1.text: No! My glorious collection! How dare you?!

grabby_threat_1.direction: [mischievously] Your king would look lovely in my vault.
grabby_threat_1.text: Your king would look lovely in my vault.

grabby_threat_2.direction: [excited] One good roll and your king is mine!
grabby_threat_2.text: One good roll and your king is mine!

grabby_threat_3.direction: [whispers] I spy your king. [gleeful] Very collectible!
grabby_threat_3.text: I spy your king. Very collectible!

grabby_win_1.direction: [laughs] Victory and total plunder! [gleeful] What a splendid haul!
grabby_win_1.text: Victory and total plunder! What a splendid haul!

grabby_win_2.direction: [gleeful] All your squares and treasures are mine! [laughs]
grabby_win_2.text: All your squares and treasures are mine!

grabby_win_3.direction: [smug] Greed is good, but winning is priceless!
grabby_win_3.text: Greed is good, but winning is priceless!

rampage_capture_1.direction: [shouting] Obliterated! [menacing] One less obstacle in my path.
rampage_capture_1.text: Obliterated! One less obstacle in my path.

rampage_capture_2.direction: [menacing] Cut down! Your ranks crumble before me.
rampage_capture_2.text: Cut down! Your ranks crumble before me.

rampage_capture_heavy_1.direction: [shouting] Crushed! Your mightiest defender falls into dust!
rampage_capture_heavy_1.text: Crushed! Your mightiest defender falls into dust!

rampage_capture_heavy_2.direction: [shouting] Devastating strike! [laughs] You cannot withstand my assault!
rampage_capture_heavy_2.text: Devastating strike! You cannot withstand my assault!

rampage_capture_heavy_3.direction: [triumphant] Your high command is broken! [shouting] Smashed to pieces!
rampage_capture_heavy_3.text: Your high command is broken! Smashed to pieces!

rampage_empty_roll_1.direction: [frustrated] The dice stall my fury. [menacing] Savor your brief respite.
rampage_empty_roll_1.text: The dice stall my fury. Savor your brief respite.

rampage_empty_roll_2.direction: [angry] No targets?! Unacceptable! [menacing] Next turn you fall.
rampage_empty_roll_2.text: No targets?! Unacceptable! Next turn you fall.

rampage_empty_roll_3.direction: [whispers] A momentary pause before the storm resumes.
rampage_empty_roll_3.text: A momentary pause before the storm resumes.

rampage_intro_1.direction: [menacing] Step forward. Your king will not survive this day.
rampage_intro_1.text: Step forward. Your king will not survive this day.

rampage_intro_2.direction: [menacing] No mercy. No retreat. [shouting] Let the battle begin.
rampage_intro_2.text: No mercy. No retreat. Let the battle begin.

rampage_intro_3.direction: [shouting] Prepare yourself! [menacing] I strike without hesitation.
rampage_intro_3.text: Prepare yourself! I strike without hesitation.

rampage_loss_1.direction: [angry] Impossible! [shouting] How could my onslaught fail?!
rampage_loss_1.text: Impossible! How could my onslaught fail?!

rampage_loss_2.direction: [sighs] You fought fiercely... I acknowledge your triumph.
rampage_loss_2.text: You fought fiercely... I acknowledge your triumph.

rampage_loss_3.direction: [angry] Downed, but not broken! [menacing] We will battle again!
rampage_loss_3.text: Downed, but not broken! We will battle again!

rampage_threat_1.direction: [menacing] Your king is in my sights!
rampage_threat_1.text: Your king is in my sights!

rampage_threat_2.direction: [whispers] The right roll, and your king falls!
rampage_threat_2.text: The right roll, and your king falls!

rampage_threat_3.direction: [whispers] I can smell your king's fear! [laughs]
rampage_threat_3.text: I can smell your king's fear!

rampage_win_1.direction: [laughs] Total annihilation! [shouting] Kneel before the conqueror!
rampage_win_1.text: Total annihilation! Kneel before the conqueror!

rampage_win_2.direction: [triumphant] Your army is crushed beneath my heel! [laughs]
rampage_win_2.text: Your army is crushed beneath my heel!

rampage_win_3.direction: [smug] Victory was inevitable! You were completely outmatched!
rampage_win_3.text: Victory was inevitable! You were completely outmatched!

rolly_capture_2.direction: [cheerful] Got one! Every little piece counts!
rolly_capture_2.text: Got one! Every little piece counts!

rolly_capture_heavy_1.direction: [gasps] Whoa! [excited] Did I really just grab that big piece?!
rolly_capture_heavy_1.text: Whoa! Did I really just grab that big piece?!

rolly_capture_heavy_2.direction: [excited] Look what I found! [laughs] Down goes a heavy hitter!
rolly_capture_heavy_2.text: Look what I found! Down goes a heavy hitter!

rolly_capture_heavy_3.direction: [squeals] Yay! [excited] That was a huge capture!
rolly_capture_heavy_3.text: Yay! That was a huge capture!

rolly_empty_roll_1.direction: [giggles] Oops, nowhere to go! [cheerful] Your turn!
rolly_empty_roll_1.text: Oops, nowhere to go! Your turn!

rolly_empty_roll_2.direction: [curious] Nothing to move? [laughs] That's dice for you!
rolly_empty_roll_2.text: Nothing to move? That's dice for you!

rolly_empty_roll_3.direction: [gasps] A blank roll! [giggles] Well, that was silly!
rolly_empty_roll_3.text: A blank roll! Well, that was silly!

rolly_intro_1.direction: [excited] Hey! Let's roll and see what happens!
rolly_intro_1.text: Hey! Let's roll and see what happens!

rolly_intro_2.direction: [cheerful] Dice ready, board ready! [giggles] Let's have fun!
rolly_intro_2.text: Dice ready, board ready! Let's have fun!

rolly_intro_3.direction: [excited] I love rolling dice! [mischievously] Hope they're friendly today!
rolly_intro_3.text: I love rolling dice! Hope they're friendly today!

rolly_loss_1.direction: [pouting] Aww, good game! [cheerful] You got me fair and square!
rolly_loss_1.text: Aww, good game! You got me fair and square!

rolly_loss_3.direction: [sighs] You're too good! [excited] Let's play another round!
rolly_loss_3.text: You're too good! Let's play another round!

rolly_threat_1.direction: [curious] Ooh! [mischievously] Your king is right in my path!
rolly_threat_1.text: Ooh! Your king is right in my path!

rolly_threat_2.direction: [mischievously] One lucky roll and your king goes boop! [giggles]
rolly_threat_2.text: One lucky roll and your king goes boop!

rolly_threat_3.direction: [whispers] Psst... your king might want to hide!
rolly_threat_3.text: Psst... your king might want to hide!

rolly_win_1.direction: [excited] Yay, I won! Can we roll again?!
rolly_win_1.text: Yay, I won! Can we roll again?!

rolly_win_2.direction: [laughs] Woohoo! [cheerful] The dice were super friendly today!
rolly_win_2.text: Woohoo! The dice were super friendly today!

rolly_win_3.direction: [excited] High five! [giggles] That was so much fun!
rolly_win_3.text: High five! That was so much fun!
